186003.description: Kitada Gaku is a prodigy in Mathematics and a scholarship holder at Wels Private Academy, a renowned institution with a long history in the International Mathematical Olympiad. After a series of unfortunate events, he meets Asakura Kai, a culinary prodigy with his own catering business. What does the future hold for these two geniuses, and how do their paths intertwine with each other's?

Ghost of Tsushima Legends follows one of the last remaining samurai as he defends his homeland of Tsushima against the Mongol Empire.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

186043.description:
My Melody opens a cake shop in Mariland. After encountering a heart in the forest, strange things start happening around her. Meanwhile, Kuromi's Japanese sweets shop across the street is always empty. Kuromi searches for the secret to My Melody's cakes. My Melody and Kuromi work hard to prepare for a sweets-making contest judged by the world-famous pastry chef Pistachio. However, no one knows that this will lead to an incident that threatens the fate of Mariland.

(Source: Netflix)
synonyms: マイメロディとクロミ

186052.description:
Ryou is delighted to be reincarnated into the fantastical world of Phi, where he thinks he’ll get to live a quiet life learning to use his newfound water magic. Going with the flow here, however, means something very different. Ryou is immediately pitted against the wild lands he winds up in and the slew of deadly monsters that call the remote subcontinent home. You’d think he’d forget about taking it easy when he’s stuck fighting for his life, but lucky for Ryou, he’s naturally optimistic, clever, and blessed with the hidden “Eternal Youth” trait. Twenty years pass in the blink of an eye, and each encounter along the way pushes him one step closer to the pinnacle of human magic. Little does he realize that’s only the opening chapter of his tale. A fateful meeting soon thrusts Ryou to the forefront of history, forever changing the course of his life... Thus begins the adventures of the strongest water magician the world has ever seen—who also likes to do things at his own pace!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

186057.description:
Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she’s determined to carve her own path.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival

title.native: 乙女ゲームのヒロインで最強サバイバル

186058.description:
Episode 1

Teddy Steady & Teddy Steady: One More!!
Rina Sanjou, a tanned gal, secretly has feelings for Zen Narazaki, her younger childhood friend who is uncool and boring. Zen is made to cosplay as a bear, and Rina is warmed by the sight of him in it. They've been playing dress up since they were little, and as an extension of that, she's been sucking Zen's dick. They've been doing that for a long time. But Zen says he wants to end their relationship. With a sense of despair, Rina tells him her true feelings. "Because it's with you... I want to play dress up. Because it's with you... I want to have sex." And so, the two finally understand each other's feelings, and become immersed in a world of love and romance.

Episode 2

Oohata-san wa Risou no Gal
On his first day at his new school, Shigeharu Miyata finds his ideal gal, Juria Oohata. Everything about Juria is ideal from head to toe, and he's happy just to be allowed to be with her; she's his one and only favorite. Is it a crush, a confession, does he like her, or does he want to do it!? From now on, look at me, not through the lens of a camera!!

Kanojo no Kawaii Mieppari
Sara Yamaguchi and Takayuki Hara have only recently started dating. When Takayuki tells Sara in a hotel bed that it's his first time, Sara boasts that she'll take the lead. A first for someone with the appearance of a gal?! She can't really tell him that she's still a virgin now. In the midst of all this nervousness, she is so frightened at the sight of Takayuki's hard cock that she slaps him. Her awkwardness lets him know that she's a virgin. It's tough... painful... but I want more... I love you ♡

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

When the Master came through a vortex into TZ’s time, his powers were weakened, and he was transformed into a sock. However, when the little girl puts the sock on her foot she transforms into a super heroine – a kick-ass Kung Fu girl, and together they must complete Kung Fu Wa’s mission and follow the ancient scroll to defeat evil and protect their world.

(Source: Federation Studios)

Nervous to meet one at first, Mari soon learns there's more to him than his furry exterior. In fact, the more she gets to know him, the more she finds herself drawn to him, his steadfastness, his kindheartedness, and…his body…

With no time to make sense of what’s happening, Stephan soon finds himself living with the unpredictable, wholehearted Chao. As her sincere love begins to break down his emotional barriers, an unexpected and touching romance begins to unfold.

Why can't I get things done?

One day, guided by an invitation letter left behind by her late grandmother, she enters “Wonderland".
There she meets a girl named Alice and they begin their journey together.

Rise meets the White Rabbit, the Caterpillar, the Queen of Hearts, the Trumpeter, the Mad Hatter and the March Hare, Humpty Dumpty, the twins Tweedle Dum and Tweedle Dee, the Cheshire Cat and ......
The residents of Wonderland appear one after another in front of Rise!
And the crazy commotion that ensues!
What kind of future will Rise choose in this crazy adventure with Alice?

This adventure will surely bring a smile to your face tomorrow!

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

Regardless, the three begin a life together as a family in order to nurture Alma's powerful AI and help her evolve into the ultimate robot. Alma's curiosity has no limits as everything she sees and touches is new to her. Alma keeps Enji and Suzume on their toes with her unmatched learning capabilities and unstoppable energy as she explores the bigger world. A brand-new kind of family comedy (?!) begins!!

The truth is, while she may be one of the not-so-mythical bloodsuckers, she doesn't really live up to the hype. She's short and clumsy, and she can't even suck blood properly! 186744.description:
When she doesn’t feel well, when there’s a test, when she doesn’t want to go to school... I take her place. I’m her replica. I’m not meant for anything else. But that changed when I fell in love. I wear my hair up so the boy I fell for knows it’s me. We skip school and promise to meet again tomorrow, and every day after. I’m her replica. Everything about me is borrowed and empty, but my heart is mine.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: รักฉันเทียมเธอ

title.english: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
title.native: レプリカだって、恋をする

186750.description: Mix JUICE's members are about to give a concert, they are interviewed by journalists about how the band were created. Each member gave a different story! Then, each girl sing alone but only a part of the crowd is moved. Finally they perform together and then, we learn from the producer Hanagata how he recruited the girls to give birth to Mix JUICE.

186757.description: The down-and-out fairy Yao Ji who traveled through time and space! The young Liu Ling who needed to see himself found the magic stone. The two reached a cooperation and found the concubines with special skills to teach them. Liu Ling successfully started his journey to the East Palace. As they spent time together day and night, he suddenly found that he had different feelings for Yao Ji...
synonyms: Everything is Fine with the Emperor

186758.description:
The protagonist, Lin Feng, was originally a genius robotics engineer. To enhance the capabilities of his super-powered robot, he painstakingly unearthed a mysterious ancient treasure from the abyss—the Eye of the Ancestral Dragon. Just as he was about to transfer the Eye's energy into his robot, the divine power within was accidentally activated, triggering a spacetime vortex that transported Lin Feng to an ancient god-like continent that revered martial arts, where he was reborn.

The reborn Lin Feng had his memories of his past life sealed, becoming an ordinary person who only awakened a healing-type martial soul. He faced cold shoulders and even had his fiancee break off their engagement. His fiancee's clan, determined to eliminate any future threats, ruthlessly attacked and killed him. In this moment of crisis, Lin Feng awakened his memories of the Eye of the Ancestral Dragon and was overjoyed to discover that its divine power had successfully fused with his super-powered robot. Subsequently, with the robot's assistance, he gradually mastered the Eye of the Ancestral Dragon's power and embarked on the path to becoming a powerful figure.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

186762.description: Set in the Three Kingdoms Period, ancient China, India presents Cao Cao an elephant. Cao Cao wants to know the elephant's weight, only his youngest son Cao Chong comes up with an idea to weigh the jumbo.

186764.description:
Alice's life has been miserable ever since she started playing SINoALICE. In despair at the world, she takes her own life, but wakes up and finds herself within the game, interacting with the game's navigator characters Parrah and Noya, who throw every despair of her previous life at her. As Parrah and Noya take Alice away, the game's characters plan to face the two.

(Source: Anime News Network)
186764.hashtag: #シノアリス #一番最後のモノガタリ

title.native: シノアリス 一番最後のモノガタリ

186789.description:
If ever there was an opportunity to enjoy canned chuhai alone with 'that' married woman... Tsuyoshi is a college student living the lazy life. As he reaches for a canned chuhai to perk things up, a charming, married woman with a catch appears before him, and they have a drink together. As the two get closer and closer, skin to skin, no doubt something's bound to happen! An immoral anthology series mixed with married women and strong canned chuhai!

(Source: OceanVeil)

186794.description:
Akira Oda and his high school classmates are summoned to another world! While the other students are granted cheat abilities through the summoning, Akira merely gains the abilities of a mediocre “assassin.” However, his status soon surpasses “hero,” the strongest profession. After Akira becomes suspicious of the King behind the summoning, he is falsely framed for a crime and forced to flee.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: ถึงเป็นแค่นักฆ่า แต่ดูยังไงข้าก็เทพกว่าผู้กล้าซะอีก

186822.description:
Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad...

(Source: Yen Press)

186827.description:
When I transferred to a certain school... I find out I'm the only guy there! Shinji is alone at the school and can't make any friends, but then his classmate Hana talks to him. Shinji is excited to have made his first new friend, but she confesses to him that she is involved in adult entertainment activities to uphold public morals... For the sake of her activities, Hana decides to engage in naughty activities with Shinji!?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

title.native: 風紀委員とフーゾク活動

186829.description:
Kakurenbo
On the night of the school trip, Ryou sneaks into the girls' room alone, planning to have his first kiss with his girlfriend, Hina. However, everyone returns to their rooms and the kiss goes awry. The two decide to hide in the closet on the spur of the moment...

Motto Kakurenbo
Since their first time on the school trip, Hina and Ryou have maintained a good relationship as lovers. However, there is one problem: Ryou wants to have sex inside the school. One day during club activities, Hina is suddenly called by Ryou to the gym storage room, where he asks her for a favor...

(Source: PinkPineapple, translated)

186833.description:
After traveling to what appears to be a true Tang Dynasty world, the main character Ning Que discovers that it is actually a perilous agricultural world. He first believed that he could become superior and live a luxurious lifestyle, but he discovers that he lacks cultivation skills. He was also persecuted for thousands of miles and saw his entire family massacred when he was four years old. He discovered the baby Sangsang while he was running away from death and picked up a black umbrella in a sea of blood and dead. He discovered the will to live in despair. He takes the large black umbrella and Sangsang and launches an exciting counterattack, refusing to submit to fate.

(Source: bilibili)

186835.description: Xie Kanhua was about to be executed in the Shanglin Celestial Palace. When Su Baiyi was rescuing him, the Shanglin Celestial Palace disintegrated, and Su Baiyi was taken away by Su Jian, the Demon Lord who had voluntarily confined himself in the secluded prison for twenty years. Then the Hero Conference of Xuanwei Town is held again, Bai Jile lures Divine Official Xue, the second-best martial artist in the world to participate, plunging the martial arts world into chaos. In order to save the injured Nangong Xi'er, Su Baiyi went to the North Kunlun with Su Jian to pay a visit to Su Suomo, the ancestor of the Su family, while Yuling and Feng Zuojun respectively headed to Qingcheng Mountain and the Demon Town to learn martial arts. Under the latent tension, the Yingzhou Immortal Island reappeared. The invaders from the island issued a provocation to the martial artists, saying that those who submit will prosper, while those who resist will perish...
synonyms: บัญญัติวีรชน ภาคที่ 2

186836.description:
Since ancient times, Dahe Shenzhou has been a land where virtue and evil have been at odds. Numerous justice-related sects have banded together to combat the evil's twelve irresponsible sects. The justice Jinyi Sect's low-level supernatural power is Li Wannian, who possesses ordinary cultivation. He wants to live a life of peace and quiet, lying flat in the Jinyi Sect and receiving a salary.

He unexpectedly learned, however, that he possessed the eternal capacity to instantly resurrect at the point of life-or-death crisis while completing a task to deal with the transfer. More significantly, he can improve his cultivation after each resurrection by receiving incentives in the form of points based on his overall performance at the time of his beheading. To put it another way, Li Wannian has to make a valiant sacrifice, and in a way that inspires and motivates others if he hopes to advance his cultivation.

synonyms: Tian Guan Ci Fu Short Films
天官赐福 全新动画短片
Tian Guan Ci Fu Quanxin Donghua Duanpian

186855.description: A boy and a girl work on a farm. The boy takes a break to play the violin which the girl and farm animals love to hear. The farm owner was mean and smashed the boy's violin. In his sad state he encounters a witch disguised as a donkey and offers her his payment of the day, stale bread, as that is the only food he had. The witch is grateful and grants the boy one wish.

186861.description:
After the heavenly lightning, although Ne Zha and Ao Bing survived by becoming Spirits, they would soon dissipate completely. Taiyi plans to rebuild Ne Zha and Ao Bing's mortal bodies with the Seven-colored Precious Lotus. However, during the process of reconstruction, numerous obstacles arise. What will become of the fate of Ne Zha and Ao Bing?

(Source: AMC)

Ne Zha 2: O Renascer da Alma

186863.description:
The story follows a fire-breathing, human-hating dragon raised by a mother cat in a forest. The dragon, known affectionately as "Uncle Wing," watches over the many curious cats — such as one that goes on an adventure with a human prince, and another that lives in the city and people-watches as a hobby — and gradually warms up to humans along the way.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and dAnimeStore. The original TV broadcast started on July 4, 2026.

186914.description:
The ninja banish evil from the shadows. The gokudo gather lonely outcasts and commit crimes. The grudge they forged centuries ago is rekindled in the present day. The ninja Shinoha meets Kiwami, a gokudo with the face of a businessman. Unknowing of the other's identity, they bond over anime, but the war between ninja and gokudo intensifies. Who will survive and who will perish, ninja or gokudo?

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

186920.description:
Two young girls, Youko and Airi, travel through an empty post-apocalyptic world.

They photograph the scenery of famous places all to themselves and camp out in towns full of nature.

The two of them ride and travel on a Serow off-road motorbike together, experiencing a never-before-felt freedom in travel with no traffic and no traffic lights.

With the Serow bike, they embark on a journey around a now-destroyed Japan; a unique story about touring on a bike comes to life as an anime series!

The world's over now, so let’s hop on a bike and go on a journey!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: Riding a motorbike at the end of the world...
